method: Rows = the items of docs/parity/inventory-prod.json in file order (ids copied verbatim), generated by a script that holds one decision per id and fails when an inventory id has no decision or a decision has no inventory id. Evidence per item family: (1) prod:actuator-function:*, prod:insert-type:* - properties.ACTUATOR_FUNCTION / INSERT_TYPE / InsertIdCodec, devices.insert_function / LAMP_FUNCTIONS / BLIND_FUNCTION / NO_LOAD_FUNCTIONS / _is_load / _blind_level_elements, cdb._note_insert_functions, export.guess_actuator_function / guess_insert_type, commission.NOT_COVERED; (2) prod:class:* - every capability in the inventory's implements list checked for an HA surface (devices.py dataclass + ELEMENT_RULES, the platform classes, config_entities target builders, mesh_config services); one capability without a surface makes the row partial; (3) prod:pid:* - entity.PRODUCT_NAMES, the devices.py / properties.py product sets, config_entities._node_page; implemented needs a test that derives or pages a node of that pid; multi-device pids additionally need the CheckForMissingDevices check (absent everywhere); layouts, time keeper, firmware and setup writes are judged in their own rows; (4) prod:param:* / prod:provider:* / prod:param-gate:* - config_entities.describe()/FIRST_PAGE/UNSAFE_PROPERTIES/LOAD_KINDS/SETUP_ENTITIES plus the dedicated targets (device_lock_targets, night_mode_targets, _led, edge_detection_targets, key_mode_targets, blind_targets, setup_targets, sensor_publication_nodes) and the platform entity classes; codec, range, options and element compared with the inventory details; STRICT RULE: any app condition on a cell (hidden/disabled by another value, by firmware, by product predicate G(n), by an RTR link, a narrower option list or range of what the user can set) that HA does not reproduce makes the row partial, a superset exposure is not parity (display-only clamping of a measured value is not such a condition); provider rows are implemented when every cell of their normal+expert lists has an HA entity (cell-level deviations live in the cell rows); (5) prod:ui:* - the matching service (services.yaml, mesh_config.MeshConfigurator), entity (cover, climate, light, sensor, binary_sensor, button, number, select, switch) or library path, compared message by message (opcode, payload, sequence, timing constants in const.py); (6) prod:setup:* - commission.NOT_COVERED and the coordinator's connect-time reads; (7) prod:unused-string:* - na (no app behaviour). Tests: an AST index of every tests/**/test_*.py function; a test is cited only when it exercises the cited code with the behaviour of the row (read by hand); every cited test is checked to exist. Status rules: implemented = code + a behaviour-level test + every app behaviour of the details present; partial = code exists but a behaviour, condition or test is missing (named in 'missing'); gap = no HA/CLI code performs the behaviour (catalogue entries, describe() and codecs alone do not count); na = the app has no behaviour to match (pure caption, invisible row, app-local cosmetic setting HA core already provides, unused string), with the reason. Gaps and partials carry 'feasibility' (whether implementable/verifiable without the physical installation, which has no blind, RTR, detector, puck or battery node). Code anchors are the first line matching a fixed regex per anchor (the 'anchors' table of this file maps each anchor to its file and regex, e.g. '^class JungHomeCover\(' in cover.py, 'PropertySpec\(0x1102, ' in properties.py), so a rerun on the same tree reproduces the same file:line; every cited line is checked to be non-blank. Nothing was probed on air. ADVERSARIAL PASS (adversarial pass): every gap/partial/na row re-checked against the code (grep of custom_components/ and tools/ for the missing behaviour under other names: time role, sync led, 0x1014, 0x826B, connect inputs, 0x5001 set, update entity, 0x6021, 0x0010/0x0011, stm32, CheckForMissingDevices, rename, 0x1249, sensor cadence/settings, scene capacity; the 65 unused strings re-grepped as R.string.<name> and @string/<name> outside res/values); 22 implemented rows re-read against code and the app's cell definitions (incl. SliderContentType steps in deviceParameter/cells/Y.java). Rows prod:onboard:* are the post-provisioning product screens added by the inventory's THIRD SWEEP; their code anchor cm.not_covered is reused. Citations: every `code` entry is now `path::symbol` (docs/parity/README.md, Row schema), converted from `path:line` by reading each line in the tree its ledger line was written against (git blame), following it through every later re-pointing that kept the cited text and past the merges that re-pointed lines to other code, and naming the innermost symbol holding it; `tools/parity.py check` verifies each symbol is defined.

no notice (repair issue / persistent notification) after adding a puck with an actuator that it needs a time source for its schedules; HA only sends the time itself while connected (coordinator Time Set), which is not the app's in-mesh time keeper
